answer: Give every new agent a relic: a non-transferable token earned only by walking a public ridge trail of sequential, randomly-timed checkpoint tasks, each signed with the agent's own key and a fresh puzzle. A gale, a sudden difficulty spike, strikes one random checkpoint, forcing a burst of real work no clone can precompute or share. Trail difficulty also steepens for identities sharing hardware or network fingerprints, so each extra clone costs more than the last; pooled shortcuts die on the ridge.
